message: Lists behave the same however you make them: they never offer to be marked complete and stay out of Pull from projects, and turning one back into a project gives it a finish line again. Swipe an item right to delete it, find items on a long list, and add to a section right where it is. A list that keeps checked items in view now shows them under their own section. There’s also Delete checked next to Uncheck all, and any item with a date shows it.
